questions.question: According to the text, what are petroglyphs considered to be?

options.A: A modern form of data storage
options.B: One of the earliest types of data generated by humanity
options.D: A programming language used by data scientists

questions.question: How does the passage define data science?

questions.question: What is the purpose of the DataFrame.iloc[] method?

options.A: It allows selection by both column and row using indices.
options.B: It only allows selection by column name.
options.C: It deletes all values in a specified row.
options.D: It converts the data type of the entire DataFrame to float64.

questions.explanation: The passage states that DataFrame.iloc[] enables a more powerful selection by letting a programmer select by both column and row using indices.
questions.source_quote: DataFrame.iloc[] enables a more powerful selection—it lets a programmer select by both column and row, using column and row indices.

questions.question: Which specific line of code is used to select all values in the third row?
questions.reference_answer: The code used to select all values in the third row is data.iloc[2,:].
questions.source_quote: data.iloc[2,:] # select all values in the third row
